ns2:course.label: Introduction to Aging
ns2:course.description: (HDFS 214) A multidisciplinary introduction to the study of aging; the social, psychological and physiological context of changing roles in later life; public and private policies that affect older people and their families. Same as CHLH 314, LEIS 314, PSYC 314, and REHB 314. See CHLH 314.
